original_observation: The command journal does not store a separate original page/access generation proof; an explicit same-actor replay can use a durable command after remount/reload.
initial_classification: Spec P2 communicated before final report; not experimentally executed.
correction: Absence of that extra field alone does not establish a violation. The hook actually binds its live current page/access/revocation/port/store and freshly rechecks actor/workspace/Policy before persistence and POST, then before delivery. No concrete path bypassing these existing guards was established. Do not represent this as a production fix.
normative_reading: Root clarified explicit original-command recovery remains distinct from automatic execution/new approval. The interaction of the Edit-specific cross-page rule and the turn recovery wording is not used here to invent an extra persisted field requirement.
